panels.description: Azure Resource Graph keeps backup jobs for 14 days, so unexpired recovery points older than that are not listed. Expiry is approximate: it is the backup job completion time plus the policy retention.

azureResourceGraph.query:
recoveryservicesresources
| where type == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backupjobs'
| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
| where properties.operation == 'Backup' and properties.status == 'Completed'
| extend policyId = tolower(tostring(properties.policyId))
| join kind=inner (
	recoveryservicesresources
	| where type == 'microsoft.dataprotection/backupvaults/backuppolicies'
	| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
	| mv-expand rule = properties.policyRules
	| where rule.name == 'Default'
	| project policyId = tolower(id), retentionDays = toint(extract(@'P(\d+)D', 1, tostring(rule.lifecycles[0].deleteAfter.duration)))
) on policyId
| extend dataSourceId = tolower(tostring(properties.dataSourceId))
| join kind=inner (
	resources
	| where type in ('microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers', 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts')
	| where resourceGroup =~ '${AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP}'
	| extend active = tostring(tags['active']) == 'true', namespace = strcat('liferay-', tostring(tags['project-id']), '-', tostring(tags['environment-id']))
	| summarize activeStorageId = max(iff(type == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' and active, tolower(id), '')), earliestRestore = min(iff(type == 'microsoft.dbforpostgresql/flexibleservers' and active, todatetime(properties.backup.earliestRestoreDate), datetime(null))), storageIds = make_set(iff(type == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', tolower(id), '')) by namespace
	| mv-expand dataSourceId = storageIds to typeof(string)
	| where isnotempty(dataSourceId)
	| project dataSourceId, earliestRestore, isActivePlane = dataSourceId == activeStorageId, namespace
) on dataSourceId
| where namespace == '$environment'
| extend completed = todatetime(properties.endTime), started = todatetime(properties.startTime)
| extend expires = completed + retentionDays * 1d
| where expires > now()
| extend restorable = case(not(isActivePlane), 'Inactive data plane', isnull(earliestRestore) or started < earliestRestore, 'Before database restore window', 'Yes')
| order by completed desc
| project ['Recovery Point ID'] = tostring(properties.extendedInfo.targetRecoverPoint.recoveryPointID), ['Data Plane'] = extract(@'-(blue|green)$', 1, tostring(properties.backupInstanceFriendlyName)), ['Storage Account'] = tostring(properties.dataSourceName), ['Backup Completed'] = completed, ['Expires (approx.)'] = expires, Restorable = restorable

panels.title: Recovery Points (Last 14 Days)
